outcome: neonatal cord blood gas values (PCO2, HCO3-, base excess)
cohort: 199 women with multiple gestations who underwent cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia.
finding: The use of a lumbar wedge significantly reduced the incidence of intraoperative hypotension and vasopressor requirements during cesarean delivery in women with multiple gestations.
mod_finding: The use of a lumbar wedge was associated with significantly reduced intraoperative hypotension during cesarean delivery.
